aboutUs.Introduction: \"Mifos\" iniciatyva yra 501(c)(3) ne pelno organizacija ir pasauline kurejų, finansų institucijų ir socialinių verslininkų bendruomene. Tikime, kad prieiga prie finansinių paslaugų yra pagrindinė žmogaus teise, tačiau milijardai žmonių vis dar yra atskirti nuo formalios finansų sistemos.
aboutUs.Platform Description: Mes užpildome šią spragą teikdami Mifos X platformą—pasaulyje pirmaujančią atvirojo kodo pagrindinę bankininkystės sistemą. Padarydami įmonės lygio bankininkystės technologiją nemokamą ir prieinamą, sumažiname patekimo barjerus Mikrofinansų institucijoms (MFI), Fintech įmonėms ir NVO, leisdami joms plėsti savo poveikį ir efektyviai aptarnauti \"paskutinę mylią\".
aboutUs.Mission: Paspartinti finansinę įtrauktį katalizuojant atvirojo kodo technologijų, bendruomenės ir žinių dalijimosi ekosistemą.
aboutUs.Vision: Pasaulis, kuriame kiekvienas asmuo ir smulkus verslas turi prieigą prie finansinių priemonių, reikalingų klestėti, nepriklausomai nuo jų vietos ar pajamų lygio.
aboutUs.Why Open Source: Pasirinkome atvirojo kodo modelį, nes tikime, kad finansinė infrastruktūra turėtų būti:
aboutUs.Transparent Description: Jokių paslėptų mokesčių ar neskaidrių algoritmų.
aboutUs.Affordable Description: Licencijavimo kaštų pašalinimas leidžia partneriams daugiau investuoti į savo klientus.
aboutUs.Innovative Description: Pasaulinė kūrėjų bendruomenė užtikrina, kad platforma vystosi greičiau nei bet kuris atskiras tiekėjas galėtų valdyti.
aboutUs.Secure Description: Su akimis, nukreiptomis į kodą iš viso pasaulio, saugumas ir stabilumas yra svarbiausias prioritetas.
aboutUs.Ecosystem Introduction: \"Mifos\" iniciatyva yra platformos globėja, tačiau tikroji magija vyksta ekosistemoje:
aboutUs.Community Role: Šimtai kūrėjų ir diegėjų, prisidedančių kodu, vertimais ir palaikymu.
aboutUs.Partners Role: Pasaulinis diegimo partnerių tinklas, kurie pritaiko ir diegia Mifos vietinėms institucijoms.
aboutUs.Foundation Role: Ne pelno organizacija, užtikrinanti ilgalaikį projekto tvarumą ir valdymą.

info.pearlsAbout: PEARLS is the World Council of Credit Unions’ monitoring system: Protection, Effective financial structure, Asset quality, Rates of return and costs, Liquidity and Signs of growth. Each indicator has a goal. Rates are for the fiscal year so far, worked out per year; growth is against a year earlier. Indicators that need balance-sheet categories use the tag on each ledger account (Accounting › Chart of accounts).

pearls.P1: Loan loss allowance ÷ provision required for loans more than 12 months overdue. Goal: 100%.
pearls.P2: Allowance left after covering loans over 12 months ÷ loans 1–12 months overdue. Goal: 35%.
pearls.P3: Loans more than 12 months overdue still on the books. Goal: none; they should be written off.
pearls.P4: Loans written off this year (per year) ÷ average loan portfolio. Lower is better.
pearls.P5: All recoveries ÷ all write-offs ever made. Goal: 100%.
pearls.P6: Solvency: what members’ savings and shares are worth after deducting loan losses and problem assets — (assets + allowance − loans over 12 months − 35% of loans 1–12 months − liabilities − problem assets + savings) ÷ (savings + shares). Goal: at least 111%.
pearls.E1: Loans net of the loss allowance ÷ total assets. Goal: 70–80%.
pearls.E2: Liquid investments (bank deposits) ÷ total assets. Goal: at most 16%.
pearls.E3: Financial investments (shares, bonds) ÷ total assets. Goal: at most 2%.
pearls.E4: Non-financial investments (property held to earn income) ÷ total assets. Goal: 0%.
pearls.E5: Members’ savings deposits ÷ total assets. Goal: 70–80%.
pearls.E6: External credit (borrowings) ÷ total assets. Goal: at most 5%.
pearls.E7: Members’ share capital ÷ total assets. Goal: at most 20%.
pearls.E8: Institutional capital (reserves and undistributed surplus) ÷ total assets. Goal: at least 10%.
pearls.E9: Institutional capital after loan losses and problem assets ÷ total assets. Goal: at least 10%.
pearls.A1: Loans more than 30 days overdue ÷ all loans outstanding. Goal: at most 5%.
pearls.A2: Non-earning assets (cash, fixed assets, receivables) ÷ total assets. Goal: at most 5%.
pearls.A3: Interest-free funds (net institutional capital, transitory capital and non-interest-bearing liabilities) ÷ non-earning assets. Goal: at least 200%.
pearls.R1: Loan interest, fees and penalties (per year) ÷ average net loans. Should cover costs: an entrepreneurial rate.
pearls.R2: Income from liquid investments (per year) ÷ average liquid investments. Should earn market rates.
pearls.R3: Income from financial investments (per year) ÷ average financial investments. Should earn market rates.
pearls.R4: Income from non-financial investments (per year) ÷ average non-financial investments. Should earn at least as much as loans.
pearls.R5: Interest paid on savings (per year) ÷ average savings. Should be a market rate above inflation.
pearls.R6: Interest paid on external credit (per year) ÷ average external credit. Goal: no more than the savings rate (R5).
pearls.R7: Dividends on shares (per year) ÷ average share capital. Goal: at least the savings rate (R5).
pearls.R8: Gross margin (income less interest and financing costs, per year) ÷ average assets. Should cover operating costs and provisions and still build capital.
pearls.R9: Operating expenses (per year) ÷ average assets. Goal: at most 5%.
pearls.R10: Loan loss provisions charged (per year) ÷ average assets. Enough to keep P1 and P2 on goal.
pearls.R11: Non-recurring income less expense (per year) ÷ average assets. Should be small.
pearls.R12: Net income (per year) ÷ average assets: return on assets. Goal: at least 1%.
pearls.R13: Net income (per year) ÷ average institutional and transitory capital: return on capital. Should beat inflation.
pearls.L1: (Liquid investments + cash + liquidity reserve − short-term payables) ÷ savings. Goal: 15–20%.
pearls.L2: Liquidity reserve ÷ savings. Goal: at least 10%.
pearls.L3: Cash and other non-earning liquid assets ÷ total assets. Goal: under 1%.
pearls.S1: Growth in loans outstanding over the last 12 months.
pearls.S2: Growth in liquid investments over the last 12 months.
pearls.S3: Growth in financial investments over the last 12 months.
pearls.S4: Growth in non-financial investments over the last 12 months.
pearls.S5: Growth in savings deposits over the last 12 months.

pearls.S8: Growth in institutional capital over the last 12 months.

pearls.S10: Growth in membership over the last 12 months. Goal: at least 5%.
pearls.S11: Growth in total assets over the last 12 months. Should be above inflation plus 10%.
